title: 🧾️ Repo YAML codec fixtures and wire shapes
description: 🧾️ The vector file the `🔁️codec-roundtrip` case reads and the projection every implementation of the codec must produce for it.

name.description: 🏷️ Stable vector identifier, used as the projection key prefix.

source.description: 📄️ The YAML (or JSON superset) document to decode.

CodecProjection.description: 🎯️ One canonical-JSON rendering per vector, in vector order. Canonical means: object members sorted by key, integers without a fractional part, no insignificant whitespace — so the projection carries no host-language number or ordering artefacts.

decoded.description: 📥️ `<vector name>=<canonical JSON of the decoded value>`, or `<vector name>!<error text prefix>` when the decoder rejects the document.

RoundTripProjection.description: 🔁️ The value obtained by decoding, re-encoding with the owned encoder, and decoding the result again.

reDecoded.description: 🔁️ `<vector name>=<canonical JSON of the re-decoded value>`.
